name: hexdeck

T-1.title: Migrate the build tracker into the board
T-1.description: PROGRESS.md's phase table becomes tickets. The board is the tracker.

comments.text: Phases 1-3.5 complete. The board replaces the phase table.

T-10.title: Phase 5 chunk 3: MCP server
T-10.description: hexdeck mcp serves the board as an MCP server over stdio: agents ask the board questions without the CLI. Read-only tools: board_show, board_show_ticket, board_log, board_next.

comments.text: TDD: mcp_test.go pinned first (red) — handshake, ping, tools/list golden, four tools, error paths, E2E over stdio. Then mcp.go: the JSON-RPC session, the four read-only tools, the golden tool list. Docs updated in the same commit. Coverage back above 80% (82.6%) with new CLI error-path tests.

T-11.title: Default columns: backlog → todo → done
T-11.description: The default flow: plan lots of work in backlog, bring items into todo when ready to pick up, move to done when finished. 'in-progress' becomes opt-in for work that spans multiple PRs. Update InitBoard defaults, the primer, the demo board, docs, and the BUILD-SPEC decision.

comments.text: Working on it: default columns become backlog → todo → done. InitBoard defaults, the primer, pick (claim without move unless in-progress exists), the demo board, docs, and the BUILD-SPEC decision. TDD: pick rules pinned first.

T-12.title: Comments live on the ticket, not the board view
T-12.description: The board shows ticket id and title only. Comments are for the ticket view: hexdeck show <ticket> and the web ticket detail. Remove comment counts and inline comments from board.md; keep them in ticketText.

comments.text: Working on it: comments leave the board views (board.md, board.svg, web cards, MCP board_show) and stay on the ticket view (show <ticket>, the web ticket detail, board_show_ticket). TDD: render/svg/web pins first.

T-13.title: Ticket relationships: blocks, related-to
T-13.description: Agents need to know what can run in parallel and what must come first. Add the ability to link tickets: A blocks B, A relates to B. Rendered on the ticket view and considered by pick.

comments.text: Working on it: ticket relationships. Two link kinds — blocks (the target must wait) and related (neither must come first). New ops ticket.link.added/removed, the ticket view renders the links on both sides, and pick skips a todo ticket whose blocker is not done. TDD: op parse + fold tests first, then the CLI, then docs.

T-14.title: Labels on tickets
T-14.description: A small set of labels per ticket (e.g. feature, bug, docs, infra), shown on the board card and filterable, to help agents scan and group work.

comments.text: Working on it: labels on tickets. New ops ticket.label.added/removed — one word, at most 20 chars (feature, bug, docs, infra). The board card shows labels in brackets after the title, the ticket view shows a labels: line, the SVG and web cards get a badge per label. TDD: op parse + fold tests first, then the CLI, then the renders and docs.

T-15.title: Makefile: common dev tasks in one place
T-15.description: A Makefile with the standard targets: build, test, vet, fmt, render-check, coverage. So contributors (human or agent) run one command instead of remembering the go incantations. Keep it short — it should not wrap everything, just the common paths.

comments.text: Scope update (Dan, 22 Aug 2026): the Makefile must be a REAL Makefile — `make build` actually compiles and produces the binary (go build -o), not just echo the go incantation. Wire the standard targets: build, test, vet, fmt, render-check, coverage, clean. ALSO in scope: refresh the README web-view screenshots (docs/web-*.png) and the demo board example (docs/demo) so they show the current board — labels, links, three-column flow. Screenshots were re-shot 21 Aug but T-13/T-14 features landed since, so they are stale again.

T-15 done in line with Dan (22 Aug): real Makefile with build/test/vet/fmt/render-check/coverage/clean targets; demo board shows labels + links + fresh README screenshots; also fixed a real bug found en route — nested boards (docs/demo) could not --commit (repo root walk-up, TDD TestE2ENestedBoardCommit). PR open.

T-16.title: Visual polish: web board and board.svg look like a modern SaaS tool
T-16.description: Make the web view (hexdeck web) genuinely beautiful — modern SaaS board aesthetics: clean typography, spaced cards, smooth hover/transition states, badge styling, empty-column placeholders, subtle shadows. Then apply the same design language to the generated board.svg (docs/board.svg + repo board.svg): same visual language so both surfaces look like the same product. Reference the popular-web-designs skill for proven SaaS patterns. Benchmark: Linear or Vercel-level polish.

comments.text: Visual polish landed (inline, 22 Aug): Linear-style light theme — indigo accent, card shadows, hover lift, count pills, empty-column placeholders, dragover feedback. Same language in board.svg. Screenshots re-shot in the same commit.

T-17.title: Web board cards should not carry the comment form — comments belong to the ticket detail view
T-17.description: T-12 moved comments off the board into the ticket view, but the web page still renders an Add-comment form on every collapsed board card. The form (and the comments) belong inside the expanded card detail — the web ticket view. Collapsed cards: id, title, badges only.

comments.text: Working on it: move the comment form inside the .details block so it only shows when the ticket is expanded.

Done in line with Dan: form moved inside the details block; every card now has an expandable detail (even bare ones) so the first comment can always be added. Verified in the browser: 0 forms visible collapsed, form + comments appear on expand, comment submits. Screenshots refreshed. PR open.

T-18.title: Web ticket modal: opening a ticket shows the full ticket view (Jira/Linear style)
T-18.description: Clicking a ticket card opens a full-size modal: description, status, labels, links, claim, comments, and a comment form. Ticket history too. Collapsed board cards stay id/title/badges only.

comments.text: Ticket modal shipped (inline, 22 Aug): clicking a card opens a full modal with description, links, comments, history, and the comment form. Collapsed cards are id/title/badges only. Screenshots re-shot in the same commit.

T-2.title: Run the build worker against the board
T-2.description: The worker creates, moves, and comments on tickets as it works. Code and ops land in the same commit.

comments.text: This chunk: the worker runs against the board.
The worker runbook (docs/worker.md) is written — the protocol this worker follows. Ops and docs land in the same commit.
docs/contributing.md replaced the worker runbook — the project prescribes no workflow; anyone (human or agent) reads the board, does a ticket, updates the board as they go.

T-3.title: Dogfood acceptance: board.md answers where the project is up to
T-3.description: A human reads board.md and can answer the question without opening anything else.

comments.text: The acceptance test for Phase 4.
Back to todo: no PR has delivered the acceptance test yet. Chunk 2 delivers the worker runbook.
board.md now renders descriptions and comments — the board answers the question on its own. The acceptance is pinned in ci_test.go.

T-4.title: Cold-start test: a fresh agent uses the board in one attempt
T-4.description: A fresh agent with zero context, given only the repo, creates a ticket, moves it, and comments correctly within one attempt.

comments.text: The acceptance test for Phase 4.

Cold-start test passed in one attempt: a fresh agent with zero context, given only the repo, discovered the board via AGENTS.md, created T-6, moved it, commented, and moved it to review — code and ops in one commit. Report: docs/cold-start.md. Acceptance pinned in ci_test.go.

T-5.title: V1.1: web view, MCP, snapshots
T-5.description: Only if V1 earns it. board.svg CI render + README embed, local web view, MCP server, snapshot checkpointing.

comments.text: Deferred until V1 earns it.

Snapshot checkpointing done — snapshot.json is a disposable local replay cache (digest-validated, gitignored, never committed; renders and CI always fold cold). TDD: snapshot_test.go pinned reuse, invalidation (new op, config change), corrupt-cache fallback, RenderCheck cold-fold honesty, gitignore. Closes the last V1.1 item — the board is now all done.

T-6.title: Coverage badge is dishonest — the E2E tests run the CLI as a subprocess, which go tool cover cannot see (measures 0%). Library alone is 85.6%; the badge's 44.7% is a measurement artifact. Fix: build the CLI with -cover, run E2E with GOCOVERDIR, merge via go tool covdata so subprocess coverage counts. Target ≥80% honest.

comments.text: Honest measurement wired: HEXDECK_E2E_COVER builds the E2E binary with -cover -coverpkg=./..., and go test merges the subprocess coverage into the profile. Total 80.7% (was 44.7% — the CLI's tests did not count). Pinned in ci_test.go: the badge must stay at 80% or above.

T-7.title: Docs overhaul: current-state documentation, not build history. Diataxis framework (the standard): tutorials, how-to guides, reference, explanation. Strip process narrative (chunk logs, phase history, cold-start report) from README and docs; document what the app IS: how it is built, how to use, how it works. README: quick start, real example, key concepts. Mermaid diagrams with correct fences so GitHub renders them. Simplified technical English throughout. T-7

comments.text: Docs restructured into the Diataxis set: tutorial (a real session), how-to (one task, one guide), reference (commands, op types, config, rules), explanation (architecture). README rewritten: quick start, a real session with real output, key concepts, mermaid flowchart. Process narrative stripped from README and docs; components.md folded into the reference. Pinned in ci_test.go: TestDocsDiataxis, TestDocsDescribeTheApp, TestReadmeRealExample, TestMermaidFences.

T-8.title: Phase 5 chunk 1: board.svg CI render + README embed
T-8.description: CI re-renders the demo board's SVG and fails if the committed image drifted. The README embeds the image at the repo root, so GitHub shows the live board on the homepage.

comments.text: TDD: TestBoardSVGInWorkflow and TestReadmeEmbedsBoardSVG pinned first (red), then the workflow honesty step (render --svg, cmp, git diff --exit-code), the root board.svg, and the README embed. E2E tests gained render --svg and render --check SVG coverage. Docs updated in the same commit.

T-9.title: Phase 5 chunk 2: local web view
T-9.description: hexdeck web serves the board in the browser: drag tickets between columns, click to comment, changes panel (diff, suggested message, commit).

comments.text: TDD: web_test.go pinned first (red) — golden page, state, move, comment, changes, commit, errors, E2E over HTTP. Then web.go: the embedded page, the API, the changes panel. Docs updated in the same commit.
